name: Kargul Studio Swipe File
tagline: 632 raw shots of Kargul Studio's product, website, and brand work, with type filters
description:
The Kargul Studio swipe file is a page of 632 raw shots from the studio's recent client work. It holds 313 product screens, 158 website sections, and 161 brand pieces, with filters for Product, Web, and Brand. The product shots cover SaaS dashboards, finance and health apps, AI chat apps, and mobile screens.

Kargul Studio is a design and engineering studio for scale-ups and enterprise products, founded by Marcel Kargul. It designs products, websites, and brands, and it builds them in Framer, Webflow, and Next.js. The shots carry no captions or project names. For context, use the case studies at kargul.studio/work. Index also lists the studio's Kanbaaan dashboard source.
pricing_detail: Free to view. The studio sells design and engineering services.
agent_guidance:
Use it as a reference for craft level in SaaS dashboards, finance apps, and landing page sections. Pick the Product, Web, or Brand filter first.

The images sit at /assets/images/swipe-file/showcase/<type>/project-<n>.png, and the page HTML lists all of them. The shots have no alt text beyond a number, so describe what you need before you pick one. The work belongs to the studio's clients. Use it as reference only, and do not copy it into a product.
why_it_matters: It shows one product studio's recent output in one place, as a quick benchmark for SaaS product and landing page craft.
tier_reason: A large set of high-quality product, website, and brand shots. The shots have no captions, project names, or search.
notable_for: dashboards, finance apps, and AI chat apps
evidence: Checked https://kargul.studio/swipe-file, the home page, robots.txt, and sitemap.xml on 2026-10-12. The page HTML lists 632 distinct images: 313 under product, 158 under web, and 161 under brand. Three sample images returned HTTP 200 as PNG. A visual check of 30 samples showed client work such as DefendLab, Opsis Partners, and TxtCart. The home page describes the studio and reports 75+ completed projects. Marcel Kargul's X profile names him as the founder of Kargul Studio. The preview is a page screenshot, because the Open Graph image is a text card. Source tweet: https://x.com/marcelkargul/status/2108960108147552273.
